links.outcome: LLM error-detection F1 under standard prompting versus structured RadCoT prompting across seven models
links.effect: Mean micro-averaged F1 rose from 0.77 ± 0.06 (standard) to 0.85 ± 0.06 (RadCoT; p = 0.003); interpretation errors improved from 0.57 to 0.75.
links.quote: RadCoT significantly improved the mean micro-averaged F1 across all models from 0.77 ± 0.06 (standard) to 0.85 ± 0.06 (RadCoT; p = 0.003).

unlisted_practices: Domain-specific chain-of-thought prompting to improve LLM detection of errors in radiology reports
Using open-source on-premises LLMs for privacy-preserving radiology report quality assurance

screen.reason: Evaluates whether adding domain-specific structured chain-of-thought prompting (RadCoT) compared to standard prompting improves error detection across multiple LLMs on retrospective radiology report QA data.
